summary: This re-adopts PR #610 (Sales Pipeline Interactive Dashboard) plus a legitimate fix-forward addendum that closed a real RLS gap. The new crm_sales_targets table is additive-only, gated behind the existing requireSalesEnabled check, correctly org-scoped via withTenantContext, and the migration now carries the standard app_runtime_tenant_isolation/service_role_bypass RLS policy pair matching the repo's established precedent (0101_wave115), plus org_id and (org_id, month) indexes matching the actual query patterns in crm-service.ts. The stage-normalization layer is additive/non-destructive (existing 5 legacy free-text stage values map onto the mockup's 8 canonical names; unrecognized future values fold safely into "Lead" rather than being dropped), and does not touch the existing opportunities kanban or CRUD flows. setSalesTarget validates both month format and targetValue (Number.isFinite) server-side. Verified independently: requireSalesEnabled, users, and compliance.current_org_id() all genuinely exist and are used correctly; no import cycle between crm-service.ts and the new pure aggregation module; the tenant-isolation.test.ts additions follow this file's own pre-existing (if generically weak, mock-heavy) convention rather than introducing a new pattern, so not a regression. The one real, disclosed gap is that a full `bun run build` (Turbopack production build) was never completed in the authoring sandbox (timed out, then apparently OOM'd) -- tsc/eslint/unit tests all pass and were used as a proxy, and this is honestly flagged in PROGRESS.md rather than hidden. Given this touches drizzle/*.sql and schema.ts, tier2 classification is correct regardless of approval; holding for human sign-off, and recommending the human re-run a full `bun run build` before merge given that gap.
issues: Full production build (`bun run build`) was never successfully completed in the authoring sandbox (timed out once, then likely OOM'd on retry) -- only tsc/eslint/unit tests were used as a substitute proxy, per this repo's own quality-gate rule (Rule 10 of SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md) a passing full build should exist before merge; recommend the human reviewer run it before merging.

sales-pipeline-rls.test.ts asserts RLS/index clauses by regex-matching the same migration file the diff itself wrote, rather than against a live Postgres pg_policies/pg_class.relrowsecurity check -- this is honestly disclosed in the test's own header as a known limitation (no DATABASE_URL available in-sandbox), not a hidden gap, but a live-DB verification is still a real follow-up worth tracking.
No settings/admin UI exists yet for setSalesTarget -- only a raw POST endpoint -- disclosed as out of scope per the mockup in PROGRESS.md; flagging in case the Owner wants a UI for it.
